rationale: Multiple subsystems change (cli, skills, audio/core, validate, render-pipeline) but all edits are additive warnings and optional auto-chunking; a new build-time step to embed freshness signals is straightforward metadata compilation, not a structural release-machinery change.

signals.blast_radius: Approximately 6-10 files across cli package (version embedding), skills scripts (staleness warning), audio or core (length estimator), validate command, render-pipeline, and SKILL.md docs; all additions are independently revertible.
signals.unresolved: Whether TTS auto-chunking is the default (warn-only versus auto-split over-length blocks) and whether CLI staleness should silently prefer fresher build or warn on mismatch; neither changes the file list, both defer to approval time.
signals.irreversibility: Fully revertible—warnings can be silenced, auto-chunking toggled on/off, build metadata removal stops the embedding, no schema changes, no data migration, no breaking API surface.
